ablation_behavior_off: Set h_i to its training-set mean and remove p_ij edge consistency, giving all items the same fixed c; retain curved quantization, architecture, schedule and codebook sizes.
ablation_both_on: Use per-item c_i from training-only normalized transition entropy, Poincare exp maps/geodesic assignment at all levels, and the sparse successor geodesic consistency term; run fixed 3,000 epochs and frozen Stage3 evaluation.
ablation_geometry_off: Keep h_i, p_ij, and edge weighting but replace exp/log maps and geodesic distances with Euclidean vectors and squared Euclidean distances; use training-only scale matching for the edge term.
behavior_computation: Count ordered consecutive item transitions inside training user histories only; form additively smoothed p_ij using training-only item-frequency prior pi; compute normalized entropy H/log(max(2,d_i)) over observed plus smoothed successor support. Cache h_i once before Stage2.
behavior_signal: Normalized entropy/effective branching of the directed next-item distribution.
cost_estimate: Precompute H_i,h_i from sparse transition counts O(T+N*degree), negligible cache. Per assignment adds a per-item curvature scale and existing hyperbolic distance cost O(B*K*D); continuation regularizer adds sparse successor-code lookups O(B*degree*D) for sampled edges. Frozen scale: 24,556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3,000 epochs = 72,000 steps and 73,668,000 item presentations; no extra full-catalog pass per step. Expected 5-15% wall-clock overhead depending on sparse edge sampling; measure on the four-card baseline.
coupling_equation: k_{il}=argmin_k d_{c_i}(exp_0^{c_i}(u_{il}),exp_0^{c_i}(e_{lk}))^2 + lambda*a_i*sum_j p_{ij} d_{c_i}(e_{l,k_{il}},e_{l,k_{jl}})^2, where c_i=c_min+(c_max-c_min)(1-h_i); the behavior term (p_ij,h_i) sets the curvature c_i of the curved assignment and successor score.
coupling_path: Transition probabilities yield h_i and c_i; c_i determines the exp map and geodesic distance ranking the residual codewords, while those same selected codewords are compared along training successor edges under d_{c_i}. Removing behavior makes curvature constant and removes edge weighting; Euclidean replacement removes both curved map and distance.

evidence_revision.answers: answers the behavior_dependency gap by acknowledging that the proposed distance scaling does not change top-1 assignments
evidence_revision.evidence_note: Positive row scalar leaves every arg-min unchanged: True. Codeword-dependent weight moved: False of the top-1. No other supporting measurements provided.
evidence_revision.revision: Withdraw the claim that branching-conditioned curvature moves assignments: the evidence shows a positive row scalar leaves every arg-min unchanged, so the specified per-item curvature weighting alone cannot steer the quantizer's assignments; the continuation-entropy motivation and downstream hierarchy claims are unsupported by this probe
evidence_revision.withdrawn: The claim that the specified per-item curvature scale can move assignments or thereby shape all four assignments

falsifiable_hypothesis: Normalized continuation entropy predicts how much semantic branching an item actually needs. Curvature conditioned on it will reserve a small, stable prefix for low-branching behavior and use later residual tokens for genuine alternatives, improving joint beam survival rather than just shifting information to T4. Keep only if full run raises joint survival and Stage3 test_R@10 above .065, with T3/T4 metrics moving in the predicted direction versus each ablation.
hyperbolic_location: Every residual assignment in Stage2 and the successor consistency regularizer; c_i is fixed per item from training data and applied to the latent and codebook points.
hyperbolic_operator: Item-conditioned Poincare exponential map and geodesic codeword distance with negative curvature -c_i, plus geodesic distance in the continuation consistency term.
key_change: Estimate each item's effective successor branching and use it to condition the negative curvature in a shared Lorentz/Poincare hierarchical quantizer. Low-branching items receive stronger negative curvature (more radial separation and a short predictable hierarchy); high-branching items receive flatter curvature and retain more angular/residual capacity, with a training-only regularizer preventing the four-level path from pushing all detail to T4.
leakage_boundary: All pair counts, prior frequencies, entropy values, and any sampled successor edges come exclusively from training histories. Freeze cached h_i before validation or test evaluation; no interaction, metric, or target from those splits can enter curvature, assignments, or regularizer.
motivation: A single global curvature and residual scale spend too many tokens distinguishing items with many competing continuations, while low-branching items need a compact, easily predicted prefix and a decisive tail.
novelty: Existing transition methods use successor direction, geodesic consensus, or boundary potentials to choose/steer codes. This instead uses a training-only continuation branching statistic to set the curvature of an item-conditioned hyperbolic quantization metric, then lets the resulting radial hierarchy shape all four assignments; it does not append a behavior token or merely change codebook size.
observables: Evaluate canonical 52,855-pair L1 Hard ER (ten fixed negatives), gold-prefix survival depth 1-4 at beam width 20, teacher-forced T3/T4 NLL and top-1, and Stage3 test_R@10. Predict L1 ER flat or slightly lower with 16-64 effective groups, L1 survival up, then survival retained/improved at T2-T4; T3 top-1 near/above .70, T4 NLL lower and top-1 near deterministic; test_R@10 must exceed .065. Explicitly inspect whether gains are joint rather than a T4-only information shift.
risks: Entropy may mostly measure item popularity/data sparsity; per-item curvature can create discontinuous code boundaries, overfit rare items, or cause optimizer scale mismatch. The balance penalty may trade reconstruction accuracy for an artificial token distribution; hyperbolic effective dimension may be insufficient.
safeguards: Smooth counts with alpha>0 and cap maximum successor support; use h_i=1 for no data and confidence a_i=min(1,n_i/n0); clamp c_i to [.15,1], project all ball norms below (1-eps)/sqrt(c_i), eps=1e-5; float32 geometry and finite-gradient checks. Sample a fixed maximum number of successors per item with deterministic training-only sampling; stop gradients through argmin and neighbor IDs. Estimate conditional entropy penalty only on adequately populated training prefixes, with pseudocounts and clipped penalty; keep seeds/schedule/negative set fixed.
spec_equations: p_ij=(n_ij+alpha*pi_j)/(n_i+alpha); H_i=-sum p_ij log p_ij; h_i=clip(H_i/log(max(2,d_i)),0,1); c_i=cmin+(cmax-cmin)(1-h_i); x_il=exp_0^{c_i}(u_il); k_il=argmin_k d_{c_i}(x_il,exp_0^{c_i}(e_lk))^2; L=L_RQVAE+lambda*a_i*sum_j p_ij*d_{c_i}(e_{k_i},e_{k_j})^2+lambda_b*relu(H(T3|T1,T2)-H(T4|T1,T2,T3)-m).
spec_inputs_outputs: Inputs are training-only sparse successor counts/prior, cached h_i and confidence a_i, current residual vectors, and four existing codebooks. Output is four fixed-width tokens (with existing deterministic collision extension) and the standard reconstruction/commitment plus behavioral regularizer losses.

specification.text: From training transitions define p_ij=(n_ij+alpha*pi_j)/(n_i+alpha), H_i=-sum_j p_ij log p_ij, and h_i=clip(H_i/log(max(2,d_i)),0,1), with h_i=1 when no evidence. Let c_i=c_min+(c_max-c_min)*(1-h_i), c_min=.15,c_max=1.0, differentiable only through latent/codebooks (c_i cached). At each level l map residual u_il to Poincare x_il=exp_0^{c_i}(u_il), assign k by argmin d_{c_i}(x_il,exp_0^{c_i}(e_lk))^2. Add a training-only continuation consistency penalty lambda*a_i*sum_j p_ij min_{k in N(k_i)} d_{c_i}(e_{l,k_i}, e_{l,k_j})^2 on the first three-level prefix representatives, where N maps successor item codes through the same current codebooks; stop-gradient through the discrete neighbors. Add a tail-balance penalty lambda_b*relu(H(T3|T1,T2)-H(T4|T1,T2,T3)-m) estimated over training batches, preventing excess ambiguity from being deferred to T4.

title: Branching-conditioned curvature budget for hierarchical quantization
